title: Player returns from online payment
description: After Stripe Checkout, the browser lands on /payment-return with success or cancel copy. Close the tab and return to the club app.

steps.title: Payment submitted
steps.body: A successful Checkout return shows Payment submitted. The club plan updates shortly; you can close the page.

steps.title: Payment cancelled
steps.body: If you leave Checkout without paying, this page confirms nothing was charged. Try again from the club app when you are ready.
